description: What the payment service reads in the order service's commands.

interactions.name: charge an order
interactions.given: an order of 2 x WIDGET-1 at 2599 USD by customer c-42 (ada@example.com)
interactions.then: the provider is asked to charge c-42 5198 USD; the payment is CHARGED; the reply is payment.succeeded

interactions.name: refund an order that timed out
interactions.given: an order of 2 x WIDGET-1 at 2599 USD by customer c-42 (ada@example.com), whose payment deadline passed
interactions.consumer_state: the order's charge of 5198 USD was taken
interactions.then: the provider refunds the charge; the payment is REFUNDED; the reply is payment.refunded for 5198

interactions.name: refund a success that came after a cancellation
interactions.given: an order of 2 x WIDGET-1 at 2599 USD by customer c-42 (ada@example.com), whose charge was declined, then a success arrived for it
interactions.consumer_state: the order's charge of 5198 USD was taken
interactions.then: the provider refunds the charge; the payment is REFUNDED; the reply is payment.refunded for 5198
